flags.oz1: 2018 Qualified Opportunity Zone (Notices 2018-48 and 2019-42; CDFI Fund list of 2010 tracts, carried to 2020 tracts)
flags.oz2e: Eligible for nomination as a 2027 Qualified Opportunity Zone (Treasury list, September 2026 update; 2020-2024 ACS, 2020 tracts). Designations by Treasury had not been published when this was built.
flags.oz2e_rural: Eligible 2027 QOZ tract made up entirely of a rural area (Treasury rural_status)
flags.nmtc: New Markets Tax Credit low-income community (CDFI Fund, 2016-2020 ACS, 2020 tracts; includes high-migration rural tracts)
flags.nmtc_sd: NMTC low-income community meeting a primary severe-distress test: poverty above 30%, median family income at or below 60% of the benchmark, or unemployment at least 1.5 times the national rate. Other routes to that status are not computed.
flags.cdfi_ia: CDFI Program Investment Area (CDFI Fund, 2016-2020 ACS, 2020 tracts)
flags.lila: Low income and low access to a supermarket or large grocery store, 1 mile urban / 10 miles rural (USDA ERS Food Access Research Atlas, Large Retailer Access Map, 2019 data on 2010 tracts, carried to 2020 tracts)
flags.lila_snap: Low income and low access to any SNAP-authorized store, including convenience and dollar stores, 1 mile urban / 10 miles rural, straight-line (USDA ERS SNAP-authorized Retailer Access Map, 2025, 2020 tracts)
flags.qct26: HUD 2026 Qualified Census Tract (Low-Income Housing Tax Credit), 2020 tracts
flags.qct27: HUD 2027 Qualified Census Tract (Low-Income Housing Tax Credit; credit allocations after December 31, 2026), 2020 tracts
flags.dda26: Mostly inside a HUD 2026 Difficult Development Area: at least half of the land in designated ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (metropolitan Small Area DDAs), or in a designated non-metropolitan county
flags.dda27: Mostly inside a HUD 2027 Difficult Development Area: at least half of the land in designated ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (metropolitan Small Area DDAs), or in a designated non-metropolitan county

visitor.rule: an area (its tracts summed) has a visitor economy when at least 50 of its homes are seasonal and they are at least 3 times the national share of housing units, or it has at least 5 lodging places and lodging places per 1,000 residents are at or above the 95th percentile of places with 1,000+ residents
